## Pavel vs the external model

- Cards: 120. Mean score: Pavel 3.99, external 3.83.
- Score correlation: Pearson r = 0.03, Spearman rho = 0.06.
- Same score: 40/120 (33%); within 1 point: 106/120 (88%); 2+ points apart: 14/120 (12%).
- Same pass/fail verdict: 77/120 (64%); Cohen's kappa = 0.13.

|  | External pass | External fail |
|---|---|---|
| Pavel pass | 64 | 22 |
| Pavel fail | 21 | 13 |

Cards 2+ points apart:

| Code | Card | Pavel | External | Pavel's comment | External commentary |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| LC-B10 | Love Locks | 5 | 3 | - | Numerous small locks divide attention instead of producing a clear dominant object. |
| PP-A04 | Jelly Mould | 5 | 3 | - | Wet translucency and irregular internal detail look more realistic than the reference materials. |
| PP-A08 | Hula Hoop | 2 | 5 | - | Sharp colour bands and a bold diagonal silhouette match the simpler reference cards. |
| PP-B03 | Drive-In | 5 | 3 | - | Thin poles, cropped scenery and dispersed objects lack a clear, substantial focal shape. |
| OG-A06 | Beanstalk | 5 | 3 | - | Swirling clouds and overlapping leaves compete with the main form, reducing visual separation. |
| OG-B03 | Tower Braid | 3 | 5 | Hair is weird | Strong vertical framing, simplified masonry and bright sky separation closely match the lighthouse. |
| OG-B05 | Golden Key | 3 | 5 | - | Clean bevels, bold proportions and sharp background separation match the reference style. |
| OG-B09 | Golden Egg | 5 | 3 | - | Naturalistic egg shading and tightly woven nest detail exceed the references’ material complexity. |
| LI-A05 | Conch Shell | 2 | 5 | - | Broad sculpted planes, controlled gloss and strong colour separation match the references. |
| LI-A09 | Pearl Oyster | 5 | 3 | - | Blurred pearlescent shading and swollen shell edges look softer than the reference materials. |
| LI-B01 | Gold Coin | 2 | 5 | From first glance at it do not see connection to set | Clean relief shapes, controlled metal highlights and bold framing match the reference cards. |
| LI-C01 | Shovel | 3 | 5 | - | Crisp material changes, controlled highlights and a strong diagonal silhouette match the references. |
| LI-C03 | X Marks the Spot | 5 | 3 | Idea and execution are great here | Separated props and the large ground marking divide attention across the scene. |
| LI-C04 | Ruby Necklace | 5 | 3 | - | Numerous small chain reflections create finer metallic texture than the reference objects. |
